description: This file defines the AccountSwitcherListener interface for handling account switching events in the Nextcloud Notes Android client.

classes.name: AccountSwitcherListener
classes.description: An interface for listening to account switcher events such as adding an account or selecting an existing account.

methods.name: addAccount
methods.description: Method to trigger the addition of a new account.

methods.name: onAccountChosen
methods.description: Method called when an account has been selected, passing the selected Account object.
